T1.describe: CA AB 325 / SB 763 (algorithmic pricing): not_yet_effective on 2025-12-31, applies on 2026-01-02.

T2.describe: Hoboken and Jersey City local algorithmic bans bind only their own addresses; Newark gets neither.
T2.known_gap: Corpus gap: the Hoboken and Jersey City ordinances (D032-D035) are listed in the source pack only as links, with no ordinance text, so there is nothing to extract or cite. The zero is the honest answer; no rule is invented to fill it.

T3.describe: NJ FAIR Act: enacted 2026-07-20, effective 2027-07-01. Possible preemption of the Jersey City and Hoboken ordinances.
T3.conflict_note: the NJ FAIR Act may preempt the local algorithmic-pricing ordinance once it takes effect

T4.describe: MA pending bills S.2983 and H.5222 (algorithmic pricing). Addresses affected if enacted.

T5.describe: MA rent-control ballot question was struck on 2026-06-23. No rent cap may be reported for Boston or Cambridge.
